activity.notes: Oxford Classical Dictionary gives Antiochus III's kingship as 222–187 BCE, while some Oxford king lists begin it in 223. ATLAS uses representative start year 222 but marks it approximate to preserve the 223/222 variation; 187 is secure.

sources.title: Antiochus III the Great - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Antiochus III as king of the Seleucid Empire from 222 to 187 BCE.

sources.title: Time Line and King Lists - The Making of a King
sources.citation_text: Oxford's Hellenistic king list uses 223–187 BCE for Antiochus III, documenting the one-year variation in modern chronology.
